title: Toggle widget displaying 0 for count when there are results

comments.body:
@davidpike7 Can you provide us either a live jsfiddle, a live demo. Here or over support@algolia.com.

This will ease the debugging process.

The bug comes from the fact that where to look for the count of the toggled/untoggled values is different is the facet contains only numeric values (API automatically makes it a numeric facet). Fixing today

I'm afraid we're still having this issue. We've updated to 1.6.4 and still get a 0 on the toggle even though we have 100+ items with the flag set.

You can see the site on the link I've previously sent you.
